title: X1's control: the same season on the same fort and roster under v6.2.1 (deployed for this manifest only), where a species with no seasons is unmanaged.

predictions.expects: inactive surface species (cavy, rhino, sharks) and unseasoned cavern species arrive

kill_criterion: no inactive or unseasoned species arrives in either replicate (then X1 shows nothing)
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: v621
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); local pool=sw.buildPool(cfg); local o={}; for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.inEmbark and not e.locked then local a=cfg.assign[e.key]; o[#o+1]=e.key..'='..(cfg.allow[e.key]==nil and 'nil' or tostring(cfg.allow[e.key]))..'/'..(a and table.concat(a,'') or '') end end; table.sort(o); print('x1 roster '..#o..': '..table.concat(o,' '))

local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local o={}; for n,st in pairs((sw.FUSE and sw.FUSE.stats) or {}) do o[#o+1]=('%s runs=%d last=%d worst=%d over=%d'):format(n:gsub('seasonal%-wildlife/?',''),st.runs or 0,st.last or 0,st.worst or 0,st.over or 0) end; table.sort(o); print('x7 jobs: '..(#o>0 and table.concat(o,' | ') or 'no stats (pre-v6.3)')..' | '..sw.fuseStatus())
